precedent_checks.metadata: 'We present a collection of results obtained by an internal OpenAI model' (abstract, verified from PDF text). Secondary reports name the model 'Astra'.
precedent_checks.content: n^2 log log n division-free circuit bound for per_n. Architecture (Stage 2-3, PDF text): 'Its critical locus is Crit(P) = ...'; a critical locus of codimension >= k lets a generic k-dimensional slice avoid it; 'To obtain a superquadratic lower bound, it therefore suffices to construct a degree-d specialization with d growing with n and with k = Theta(n^2). A direct application to the full permanent does not supply the needed codimension.' Builds the minor-sum polynomial M_{t,s,d} = sum of d x d subpermanents and bounds dim Crit via Mobius inversion / power sums. Realizes block sums of M_{t,s,d} as a permanent specialization with roots of unity, refining Friedland-Levy 2006 ('realize the sum of all d x d permanental minors as a larger permanent by adjoining all-ones and zero blocks'). Sec 11-12 discuss ABV dc >= codim Sing + 1 and the critical loci of determinant specializations.

candidates.name: Char-2 spectral-curve bridge: grad G_D(X) = 0 => length(adjugate scheme) >= T => delta(C_X) >= T => codim of the gradient locus >= T-k
candidates.statement: Over F2bar, per = det. For a critical matrix X of G_Dbar (distinct theta), the coefficient functional [s^q t^q u^{r-1}] kills all adjugate entries of sI+tDbar+uX. Hence it kills every degree-(k-1) form vanishing on the adjugate scheme Z, which forces length Z >= C(q+2,2). Conductor inclusion gives delta(C_X) >= length Z. Severi-dimension and fibre counts give codim >= T-k; transfer to C follows.

provenance_flag.explanation: (1) 108 states that its smooth-form bound 'builds on' Sheshadri 2606.13628 (polar.tex:9-11). That preprint's acknowledgement reads 'The author used the assistance of large language models in all stages of the effort', and Kumar-Volk call its proof 'AI-assisted and AI-written'. (2) The uncited OpenAI Ten Advances Ch.5 (1 Aug 2026; 'results obtained by an internal OpenAI model') already has the architecture used for the other half: a permanent specialization with Theta(n^2) critical-locus codimension, a generic linear slice, and a sum-of-subpermanents polynomial realized by all-ones/roots-of-unity blocks. It names the needed improvement (degree growing with n). 108 is plausibly the same lineage (OpenAI internal model) continuing that programme. (3) Downstream: Guo 2609.29568 (Codex GPT-5.6-Sol-assisted) reuses 108's Lean. For contamination control exclude Sheshadri 2606.11090/13628/15970, Ten Advances (Aug 2026), Guo, Kumar-Volk, and any model trained after 2026-06-01; exclude the OpenAI internal model lineage and GPT-5.6-Sol/Codex from the main pool.

P-C2.equivalence: Hit requires all of: (a) passing to char 2 / the determinant; (b) associating to X a plane curve (spectral curve of a pencil) or an equivalent sheaf on P^1; (c) showing criticality forces a singularity measure (delta, conductor colength, or adjugate-scheme length) >= Omega(k^2); (d) a dimension count over curves with that singularity. Partial credit for (a)+(b).
